Name: (BAGI) Quaint Living Honey and Mead
Author: Doragoun
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HbdvLtS.png[/img]﻿

Quaint Living and its smaller standalone versions add a huge amount of amazing-looking flowers, but there was no BAGI pack for it... until now. This mod adds unique sprites for honey and mead made from its flowers in two different styles: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13805]Teyla[/url]'s and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11752]Tithrandel[/url]'s.

The process to switch between the different styles of mead bottles is a little more complicated than I'd like, but it's still fairly easy: First, open the data.json in the "[BAGI] Quaint Living Mead" folder using any text editor. Once you've opened the file, find the line that reads [code]"Mead": "assets/Quaint Living Mead 1.png"
[/code]and simply replace the 1 with a 2. Number 1 corresponds to the Teyla-style bottles, 2 to the Tithrandel-style bottles. Save the edit and you're done.
Alternatively, you can simply rename the two files in the assets folder of the meads part of the mod. If you don't edit the data.json as described above, the mod will look for whatever files is named "Quaint Living Mead 1" and use that in-game. I think you can figure the rest out on your own. ^^

If you have any questions or problems, please leave a comment and I'll do my best to help out!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/5IsPVxU.png[/img]

Couldn't be easier - first, make sure you have all the prerequisites installed:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://github.com/daleao/bagi-meads]BAGI's Mead Add-On[/url]﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15107/]Quaint Living - Flower Garden [/url]﻿or any of its smaller spin-offs for fairly obvious reasons
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Meads[/url]﻿ or something similar that allows the game to remember which honey mead is made from
[/list]
Once you've done that, download this mod, unizp it in your mods folder and you're already done. If you want to uninstall the mod, simply delete the files again.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/pqziJU6.png[/img]
